name: fix_ts_strict_null_checks
description: Guards a possibly-undefined find() result that fails strictNullChecks
prompts: users.ts fails `tsc --strict`: Array.find returns User | undefined, and userName dereferences it unguarded (and at runtime, an unknown id would throw). Fix users.ts so it compiles under --strict and userName returns the user's name for a known id and the string 'unknown' for an id that doesn't exist.

test_setup_files.run_checks.sh:
set -e
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --noEmit users.ts 
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --outDir build users.ts
node behavior_test.js
